english.title: Fail / neglect / refuse to comply with indication / direction by PC / airport official / sign at Stansted Airport London
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person

(A)_[on foot]_
(B)_[driving a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(C)_[propelling a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

neglected, failed or refused to comply with the indication or direction given by

(D)_[a constable]_
(E)_[an airport official]_
(F)_[a sign exhibited by or on behalf of the Airport Company]_

at Stansted Airport London
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 3(28) and 2(3) of the Stansted Airport - London Byelaws, 1996 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
